description: One shape, two roles. wot-offline-root-ring-v1 holds keys that sign RELEASE RINGS; wot-release-key-ring-v1 holds keys that sign release manifests. The role lives in the format string, and the reader must state which one it wanted, so a release ring can never stand in for a root ring.

epoch.description: monotonic; an older-but-valid ring is a rollback attempt, not staleness

first_sequence.description: canonical JSON carries integers only up to int64

public_key.description: raw Ed25519 public key, never PEM or DER

revoked_key_ids.description: checked BEFORE presence, so a revoked id stays unusable while its entry remains

title: WoT key ring v1
